title: Prove a sharp connector read/transfer tariff beyond minimum reads
body:
Minimum-read scheduling can miss the cheapest complete-call word. For the fixed dirty three-source/two-root interface `B0 B0 B1 B1 B2 B2`, normalized colors `(1,1,2)` and all seven nonzero target masks, this proves the exact frontier `(U,V; full-mask reads) = (2,2;4), (3,3;3), (4,2;3)`; every other target uses two reads. At unit complete-call prices, the extra-read word costs 26 versus 27 for every minimum-read word.

The all-length hand proof covers formal words implementing the endpoint for every compatible opaque linear child map, including singular/noncommuting maps. It is not an optimum for each known concrete map: zero maps and other coincidences can simplify a particular caller. For independent positive shear prices u,v and full-mask read price a7, the extra-read word wins exactly when `a7 < min(u+v,2u)`. Three explicit words attain the complete positive-price envelope.

This answers a gap expressly excluded by [PR2538](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2538), pinned at `4f854bec19601ea0ed6fb07f17b441e5f0011c84`: that solver minimizes transfers among all minimum-read decompositions and remains correct. The unmodified source is authenticated and rerun. Joint read-set synthesis is credited to that predecessor; fixed-color dirty-root framing to conorholds/PR2208 and the retained connector lineage. Pareto optimization and XOR search are standard methods, not claimed as new.

Validation from main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority4:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/connector-read-transfer-tariff
python3.12 -I -O -B research/connector-read-transfer-tariff/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/connector-read-transfer-tariff/check_integrity.py
```

Registered CPython3.12.14 replay passed: full 830-state/1145-label Pareto search; independently evolved physical-state rectangle and exhaustive read subsets; 1728 dirty forward/inverse basis columns; 27 exact price cases; 5 semantic controls. Git-free read-only relocation, executable-source rejection before execution, typed-receipt corruption and exclusive output also passed. A separate Codex agent read the proof/code and independently replayed the primary verifier under Python3.12.7 with no blocking findings. The all-length claim comes from the proof, not a finite-depth extrapolation.

Scope changed from the selected connector-alphabet card and is recorded in TASK.json: the alphabet stays fixed while the price objective changes. No actual caller, native supplier, physical speedup, rank profile, formal-kernel theorem or new kappa is claimed. Complete child tariffs must include access/frames/scratch/heads; admission, preparation and hosting beyond those calls remain separately payable, and word-dependent overhead can reverse the example saving. Open next questions identify these obligations.

Final overlap screened 756 open PRs at 2026-10-15T14:20:42Z plus 1538 local notes. The last complete Discussion snapshot has 1197 records at 12:29Z; GraphQL rate limiting leaves that coverage stale. This is not a novelty certificate.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation, validation and prose. Peer review was separate AI review, not independent human review. Existing source credit/notices are retained. No hosted-CI result is claimed.
